parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main body of the keyboard, made of durable ABS plastic that holds all keys and internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the key switches and electronic circuits.
parts.Movement_description: It is a static part and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Key
parts.Basic_description: A keycap made of ABS plastic, forming the interactive surface of the keyboard.
parts.Functional_description: It is pressed by the user to input characters or commands.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring or membrane mechanism.

parts.Functional_description: It is pressed by the user to input characters or commands.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring or membrane mechanism.
